decisions.reason: The white-label test vinyl series is a cheap, collector-oriented option whose demand is still unresolved after one year, so keeping it listed on the existing platform costs little. Limited pressings may still sell out and disappear.

The German new wave compilation series sits close to the core catalog, and its value as a series is still unfolding. Carrying it in stock and online costs little relative to its option value, so it is kept.
